channel.title: AI Threat Watch: SE
channel.description: Verified case files located in SE.

item.title: [HIGH] Researcher: free Lovable account could read source, Supabase keys and chats of pre-Nov 2025 projects
item.description: A researcher posting as weezerOSINT disclosed that any free Lovable account could access other users' source code, Supabase database credentials, AI chat histories and connected customer data for projects created before November 2025. Target: Lovable projects created before November 2025. SE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Deepfake ads of Swedish finance figures lure 5,000 savers into pump-and-dump scams
item.description: Swedish media reported at least 5,000 small savers lost about 500M SEK (about $52M) in 2025 to pump-and-dump share scams promoted with deepfake ads of journalist Gabriel Mellqvist and investor Gunter Marder on Meta. Target: Swedish retail investors. SE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Stockholm police warn of AI deepfakes of Anders Tegnell and Agnes Wold in card-theft ads
item.description: Stockholm County Police reported multiple complaints since late May 2025 about social media ads using AI to imitate well-known doctors in fake health product promotions that harvested card details. Target: Swedish consumers. SE. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Lovable-built apps leak user data: 303 endpoints across 170 projects lacked row-level security
item.description: Researcher Matt Palmer found Lovable-generated Supabase backends shipped without working row-level security, letting anyone read or write tables; a scan of 1,645 apps found 170 exposing emails, phones, payment data and API keys. Target: Apps generated by the Lovable AI app builder. SE. Verification: disputed.
